warning.title: Stop &dlm; before stopping a cluster in maintenance mode
warning.para: To put the cluster into maintenance mode and then stop or restart the cluster services, you must first stop &dlm; and any resources that depend on it, such as &gfs; or lvmlockd. When the cluster is in maintenance mode, &dlm; keeps running even if the cluster services are offline. However, &dlm; depends on &corosync;, so if &corosync; stops but &dlm; is still running, the &dlm; instances on each node consider the other instances lost and request node fencing.
